snippet.title: Little Nightmares III – You're in for a Ride | Pre-Order Now
snippet.description:
An ill-fated attempt to bring fun to the funfair. Do what you must to survive the ride, little ones. 

#LittleNightmares III comes to PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PC on October 10th, 2025. Pre-order now: https://bnent.eu/PreorderLN3

Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 preorders will open at a later date.
